top.theme: relatives asking when it is her turn at a family wedding
top.hook: Jesus... four aunties asked when it's my turn. I smiled at the wedding and cried in the car. 💍

top.theme: relatives asking salary questions at the Diwali table while her job hunt is still going nowhere
top.hook: Jesus... every aunty at Diwali asked what I earn. What do I even say? 😔
Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo. 😔

top.theme: waiting for tomorrow's result that decides his future
top.hook: Jesus... my result comes out tomorrow at ten. I told my parents I'm not nervous. 😔

top.theme: exhausted after a third late night, he fell asleep in the office washroom and told his manager he was on a call
top.hook: Jesus... I fell asleep in the office washroom for ten minutes. I told my manager I was on a call. 😮‍💨

bottom.theme: comparing her career to her batchmates' online updates
bottom.hook: Jesus... I liked every batchmate's promotion post today. Then I sat in the bathroom feeling sick. 😔

bottom.theme: she told her athai her Diwali gift is her favourite when it is not, and the small lie is eating at her
bottom.hook: Jesus... Athai's Diwali gift. Why did I call it my favourite? 🎁

bottom.theme: she promises one more reel at 2 a.m. every night and hides her exhaustion at work
bottom.hook: Jesus... it's 2 a.m. again. I said one more reel an hour ago, and I'll smile at work anyway. 📱

bottom.theme: alone in the hostel during the festival holidays
bottom.hook: Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left. 😔

bottom.theme: she cries in the bathroom with the tap running so her family won't hear
bottom.hook: Jesus... I ran the tap so my family wouldn't hear me cry. Then I came out and ate dinner. 🚿

top.theme: she always texts first and wonders if anyone would notice if she stopped
top.hook: Jesus... I stopped texting first for a day. Nobody checked on me. 💔

top.theme: father in the ICU while he is stuck in another city
top.hook: Jesus... my father is in the ICU. I told Mom I'm fine. The next train is tomorrow night. 😭

top.theme: alone in the hostel during the festival holidays
top.hook: Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left. 😔

top.theme: people-pleasing and not being able to say no
top.hook: Jesus... I said yes again. I didn't want to. I never do. 😔

top.theme: she'd rather carry her struggles alone than risk being a burden, even when she's close to breaking
top.hook: Jesus... why can't I ask anyone for help even when I'm drowning? 😔

bottom.hook: Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo. 😔
Jesus, why does everything come easy for her?

bottom.theme: she told her athai her Diwali gift is her favourite when it is not, and the small lie is eating at her
bottom.hook: Jesus... Athai's Diwali gift. Why did I call it my favourite? 🎁

bottom.theme: she cancelled on her friend three weekends in a row to rest and then spent the whole Sunday feeling guilty about it
bottom.hook: Jesus... why do I feel guilty every time I cancel plans? 😔
Jesus, it has been one year. Why does it still hurt?
